title: How to Post a Video | Brilliant Directories Documentation | BD Support
content: How to Post a Video Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000001964 To post a video, access the Member Dashboard and locate the Videos post type in the left sidebar or Videos under Publish Content . Click the option available to add a new post. IMPORTANT: If the Videos option is not visible in the member dashboard, the post type must be enabled for the specific membership plan under the post publishing tab: Finance » Membership Plans - Post Publishing Form Fields Content can be added to the post including a title, description, and link, as detailed below: Publish Status: Publish content to the site or save it as a draft. Video Title: Enter the title of the video. Category: Select the appropriate category for the video. Image: Upload an image to represent the video. If the site has the Stock Photo Library add-on it will appear under the Upload Image button. Video Link: Provide the video URL. (YouTube + YouTube Shorts, Vimeo, Dailymotion, Rumble, TikTok, TedTalk, and Wistia links are natively supported). Keywords: Enter relevant keywords separated by commas. Description: Provide a brief description of the video content. Video Link Requirements Using the Share Link When providing the video link, ensure the Share link is used rather than the browser URL: Click Copy to obtain the correct link. If the link is copied directly from the browser, the thumbnail may not generate properly, resulting in a missing image in the Video Streaming Widget or the /videos search results page. Rumble Videos For videos hosted on Rumble, utilize the link provided in the Embed IFRAME URL field: Managing Saved Video Posts Once the videos are added, the user will see the videos, actions and statistics (this option appears if site has the Member Profile Analytics Add-on). Once created, the post will display its current Status : Published, Draft, or Expired . The number of views and bookmarks will be visible if the corresponding add-ons are active on the site. Create a new video + New Video . Click on the Actions button to View, Edit, Clone or Delete. Member Dashboard Features The following options are available within the management section of the dashboard: Entries per Page : A dropdown to select the number of visible entries (5, 10, 25, or 50). Sorting Options : Sort posts by Newest, Oldest, Updated (First/Last), or Start Date (First/Last). Status Filter : Filter results by Published, Draft, or Expired status. Keyword Filter : Displays video posts containing the specified keyword. Public Video Search Page Each post type has a designated search results page accessible on the front end: Example URL: http://example.com/videos Note : To enable this post type for a specific membership plan, visit Finance » Membership Plans - Post Publishing . For additional assistance: Email support@brilliantdirectories.com or create a ticket Inside Your Account Dashboard . Was this article helpful and accurate?
